title: An empirical study of cgo usage in Go projects
core_idea: Use an automatic analysis tool (cgoanalyzer) to empirically study cgo — the Go foreign-function interface — across open-source Go projects to characterize its distribution, purposes, usage patterns, and critical issues.
tldr: Build and apply cgoanalyzer to analyze cgo usage in Go projects, with the goal of revealing how and why cgo is used, exposing problematic issue types, and proposing mitigation approaches and guidance for developers and the Go team.
